manifest.scope: Current release diagnostic characterization; no before/after product optimization. Phase timings are wall times; CPU and I/O are total process observations.

limitations: One minimum-31-second idle observation per synthetic case; not a representative source-heavy corpus or leak study.
Phase times are wall time; CPU and I/O counters are process totals.
Consistency policies have different freshness semantics; not a product before/after optimization.
Freshness latencies occur at different positions in the 30-second poll cycle.
Warm read_bytes and rchar do not capture all directory metadata/getdents work.
Original older-host client traffic remains unobserved.
Accounting checks verify the exactness flag and component sum; no separate complete-wire BPE oracle was run.
